_readme: Single source of truth for the channel-wire transport limits the Go hub/worker/CLI (backend/channelwire) and the TypeScript browser client (frontend/src/lib) both compile in. task generate-contracts emits true constants into backend/generated/contracts/wire.go and frontend/src/generated/contracts/wire.ts; the derived values (maxPlaintextPerChunkBytes, maxReassembledMessageSizeBytes, sessionKeyHardCeilingMs) are computed by the generator, not re-derived per language. Retuning any number here is a one-file change that reddens neither side's build -- there is nothing left to drift.
